thesis: Goblin Grenade turns the tribe’s smallest creature into five damage for one mana, rewarding decks that can treat a Goblin as both attacker and ammunition.

If the spell is countered, the sacrificed Goblin does not come back. The spell deals exactly five damage to one target if it resolves. With a Goblin already on the battlefield and an untapped Mountain, pay {R} and sacrifice that Goblin while casting Goblin Grenade.
